issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Farm.animals is a private attribute with a getter and setter (aggregation, initialize in constructor and provide accessors), but the solution implementation declares the animals field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch contradicts the specified encapsulation and the explicit instruction to provide a getter and setter, which may confuse students about the intended access level and usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and rely on the getter and setter as specified. Update the solution Farm.java to declare animals as private and ensure the existing getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods are used. Alternatively, if public access was intentional, update the problem statement and UML to reflect a public attribute to avoid confusion.
